scope: Pure ISO week/period/format/normalization and renderer boundary checks; browser behavior is a separate report

checks.name: Period validity and leap-year datetime validation
Periods cover whole month, quarter and ISO week
Forbidden dates invalidate entire range and calendar periods
Reversed, partial and out-of-bounds values do not become committed state
Multi-date deduplicates, sorts and excludes forbidden values
Local datetimes retain wall-clock values without timezone conversion
Scalar zero is retained in input, statistics and badges
New renderers escape labels, values, descriptions and content
Unsafe image and navigation schemes are rejected
